values.title: Preview branches
values.summary: A full copy of your backend for every pull request.
values.body:
## How branches work

Each pull request gets its own environment with the branch’s schema applied, seed data loaded and functions deployed. It’s deleted when the PR closes.

## Setting up CI

1

Connect the repository

In **Project settings → Git**, connect GitHub or GitLab.

2

Add the action

Add the Tessera action to your workflow so every push updates the branch.

.github/workflows/preview.yml

```
- uses: tessera/preview-action@v2
  with:
    project: prj_8f2k1
    token: ${{ secrets.TESSERA_TOKEN }}
```

3

Use the branch URL

The action outputs `api_url`. Pass it to your frontend preview deployment.

Data

Branches start from seed data, never production data.
